clips.title: The story
paras: At Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf seeks Bathran's Hair for a sick child in Astranaar. He believes the illness afflicts the child's spirit, and sends you north to the ancient ruins where the uncommon restorative herb was gathered in the past.

Orendil Broadleaf, a night elf herbalist at Maestra's Post, faces a troubling illness. The post lies just south of the Darkshore border. A young child in Astranaar is grievously ill, and ordinary remedies have failed. Orendil believes the sickness afflicts the child's spirit as well as the flesh. He seeks Bathran's Hair, an uncommon restorative herb gathered in the ancient elven ruins to the north.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north. The plant was called Bathran's Hair and was known to cure ailments of the spirit.

There is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness. Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for Bathran's Hair? I may need it to properly treat the child.
Bathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to Darkshore.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, friend? The child's health grows weaker by the hour...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you have the hair! Now I will mix a cure for the child, and pray my concoction works.
And... Forsaken are at Bathran's Haunt? Very troubling to hear, that is. Very troubling indeed...
